title: Listening Section 1 - Holiday Cottage Booking
instruction: You will hear a man telephoning a company to book a holiday cottage by the sea. Answer Questions 1-10.

transcript.speaker: Lucy
transcript.text: Seaview Cottages, Lucy speaking.

transcript.speaker: Owen
transcript.text: Hello. I'd like to book a cottage for a week in August, please.

transcript.speaker: Lucy
transcript.text: Certainly. Could I take your surname first?

transcript.speaker: Owen
transcript.text: It's Hargreaves. That's H-A-R-G-R-E-A-V-E-S.

transcript.speaker: Lucy
transcript.text: Thank you. Which dates were you thinking of?

transcript.speaker: Owen
transcript.text: We'd like to arrive on the ninth of August.

transcript.speaker: Lucy
transcript.text: I'm afraid the cottage with the sea view is already taken from the ninth. The earliest I can offer is the sixteenth.

transcript.speaker: Owen
transcript.text: That works for us too. We'll take the sixteenth.

transcript.speaker: Lucy
transcript.text: Lovely. How many people will be staying?

transcript.speaker: Owen
transcript.text: Four adults. There will be a dog as well, a small one.

transcript.speaker: Lucy
transcript.text: One dog is fine, but we do ask you to keep it off the furniture. Now, the price. In July the cottage is five hundred and eighty pounds a week, but in August it's six hundred and fifty.

transcript.speaker: Owen
transcript.text: That's fine. Does the price include everything?

transcript.speaker: Lucy
transcript.text: Electricity and bed linen are included, but you need to bring your own towels.

transcript.speaker: Owen
transcript.text: Okay. And where exactly is the cottage?

transcript.speaker: Lucy
transcript.text: It's about a mile from the village of Penrose. That's P-E-N-R-O-S-E. There's a small shop there, and the beach is a ten-minute walk.

transcript.speaker: Owen
transcript.text: Sounds perfect. What time can we arrive?

transcript.speaker: Lucy
transcript.text: Check-in is from four o'clock. A lot of guests think it's two, but the cleaners need the time. Check-out is at ten.

transcript.speaker: Owen
transcript.text: Understood. How do we pay?

transcript.speaker: Lucy
transcript.text: We need a deposit of one hundred and fifty pounds to confirm the booking. We don't take cheques any more, so I'll email you a link and you can pay online.

transcript.speaker: Owen
transcript.text: That's great. Thank you very much.

transcript.speaker: Lucy
transcript.text: Thank you. We look forward to seeing you in August.
